Tesla FSD V14.3.5 has just started rolling out.

One new feature: You can now open Camera Preview at any time, even if your Tesla is not in Park.

Downloading it on my Model Y right now.

We're sharing this information publicly because we've been contacted by several of our platform's members based in Australia who have observed missing vehicle data.

Due to @Telstra's recent countrywide outages and other infrastructure issues, Tesla vehicles were affected, resulting in connectivity issues and severe delays for third-party services such as ours.

While Tesla's Fleet Telemetry is designed to attempt to send stale data (resending) in the case of temporary connectivity issues, the internal storage for this data is limited, and this system is not designed for prolonged downtimes impacting cellular providers.

Whenever there is cellular downtime or while traveling through known cellular dead zones, vehicle data recording can be affected, and, as such, data loss is expected.

We appreciate our members down under for their understanding.

v14 Lite now rolling out to early access AI3 owners in Korea


Tesla Korea (@tesla_korea)

🚀풀 셀프 드라이빙(감독형) v14 Lite, 한국 상륙

오늘부터 순차 배포를 시작합니다.
업데이트는 차량별로 순차 제공되며, 적용 시점은 다를 수 있습니다. 아직 업데이트가 표시되지 않더라도 정상적인 배포 과정이므로 조금만 기다려 주시기 바랍니다.

풀 셀프 드라이빙(감독형) v14 Lite가 선사하는 더욱 자연스럽고 향상된 주행 경험을 만나보시기 바랍니다.

*풀 셀프 드라이빙(감독형) v14 Lite는 현재 미국 생산 Model 3/Y(풀 셀프 드라이빙 컴퓨터 3) 차량 중 FSD(감독형)이 활성화된 차량에 한해 제공됩니다.
*풀 셀프 드라이빙(감독형) v14 Lite는 완전한 자율주행 기능이 아니며, 모든 장애물, 도로, 교통상황을 완벽히 인식하지 못할 수 있는바, 운전자는 항상 주의를 유지하고 즉시 제어할 준비가 되어 있어야 합니다.

Waypoints will initially be available to vehicles with a Plus or Pro subscription while we analyze costs (including Tesla API and Google/Mapbox API fees).

Over time, we'll gradually provide access to this for all members and apply improvements based on feedback.

We believe this feature will help friends and family who road-trip together, as well as creators who wish to share which specific routes they took.

Waypoints are private by default. When shared, they are not associated with the account that created them.

Privacy is paramount.
